findings.title: Minister Hamad calls for international pressure to open Gaza crossings, expedite entry of relief aid
findings.location: Gaza Strip; minister's remarks in Cairo, Egypt
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced families and winter shelter response. Palestinian Minister of Social Development and State for Relief Affairs Samah Hamad reports work completed at 50 of 160 targeted displacement sites and four shelter centers established with combined capacity for 325 families. She reports approximately 12,000 requests for relief and more than 950,000 people at flood risk across 989 displacement sites. Exact operational dates and assessment methodology unknown; not necessarily changes occurring today.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: work had been completed at 50 of the 160 targeted displacement sites and that four shelter centers had been established
findings.source_type: News agency reporting named government minister's remarks

bounded_discovery_context.caveat: No original ministry dataset or independent corroboration retrieved. OCHA's 162/356 flood hotspot activities refer to a different denominator and scope; do not combine. No new crossing decision established. Historical flood totals and broad appeals not admitted as separate findings.
